name: PRILINE
summary: Long-running Amazon brand selling PLA, wood PLA (including cherrywood), ASA and TPU in 98A, 95A high-flow, 90A and 85A, at about $15-26/kg for 1 kg and $56-58/kg for 0.5 kg soft TPU. The seller is a Shunde 3D technology company; the extruder is unknown.
additional_notes: Legal entity: GUANGDONG SHUNDE ULTRALLINE 3D TECHNOLOGY CO.,LTD (verbatim, spelling 'ULTRALLINE' as printed), Shunde District, Foshan, Guangdong; Amazon seller 'Priline Direct' (id A1V5JEF00F138K), read 2026-11-06. The listing's Manufacturer field reads 'Priline'. Store is Amazon; the first pass found only an unofficial-looking website, not recorded as an endpoint. The seller is a 3D technology company occupying floors 2-3 of a building in a Shunde tech park, which leaves in-house extrusion possible but unconfirmed.

provenance.conflicts: Whether Ultralline 3D Technology extrudes the filament is unknown, and no Chinese-script registration was matched to the English name.
